caption:
Breakfast Banana Split 🍌 🍨 
lazy girl breakfast | easy recipe | egg free | 2 minute recipe 

Nutrition: 
C: 51 | F: 16 | P: 10
Calories: 372 per serve 
Serves 1

Ingredients
1 banana
40 grams greek yogurt epigamia 
1 tbsp peanut butter 
2-3 pieces ( 15 grams ) of dark chocolate, melted ( i used bournville 70% ) 
2 tbsp granola

Method 
melt chocolate
cut the banana in half and place on a plate
add on the greek yogurt, drizzle on peanut butter and chocolate then finish with granola 
enjoy :) 

Note:
I used crunchy peanut butter so to try to make it aesthetic I melted it with 1 tbsp milk but it thickened hence the video 

Wanna make it vegan? Use vegan yogurt and vegan chocolate 🥰

Either use creamy peanut butter or just scoop on crunchy peanut butter normally :)
